panels.title: Weaving around the world

keywords.def: to make fabric by passing threads over and under each other
the threads that run up and down, held still
the threads that go across, over and under the warp

questions.q: Colour the first two rows of an 'over 1, under 1' grid on the pupil PDF.
Pupil PDF: plan your weaving on squared paper with two colours and a sequence; write the sequence underneath.
questions.a: A coloured plan with a clear sequence.

questions.q: Extend: plan a border of a different pattern.
Stretch: predict what 'over 3, under 1' looks like.
questions.a: Long stripes of weft colour with small warp dots.

questions.q: The threads held still on a loom are the ...
questions.a: A) warp. Warp runs up and down.

questions.q: Think again: Look at a tea towel or a basket closely. How do the threads hold together without glue?
questions.a: They go over and under each other: weaving locks them together.
